integrationPrinciple: All five ideas are now active AR task entries in corresponding mission JSON, directly after their GPS step. Implementations and media may remain pending; 2D equivalent is required.
arAltitudePolicy: Do not use legacy Unity altitude as absolute vertical AR alignment. Use user placement, visual alignment or field-verified geospatial anchor only.

proposals.title: Пронађи торањ
proposals.interaction: Player points the camera toward City Hall; a translucent outline or visual guide highlights the tower, then a short historical year prompt appears.

proposals.title: Геније боја — три епохе
proposals.interaction: Player selects blue (1929–1933), red (1934–1940), grey (1945–1952) cards in their historical order, without needing real painting images. Three short original graphic brush strokes; same order task in 2D fallback.

proposals.title: Позорница у простору
proposals.interaction: At the theater façade, player places a small virtual stage frame and reveals a mini question about the theater history.

proposals.title: Santa Maria della Salute — stihovi u vazduhu
proposals.interaction: Reorder three title cards Santa / Maria / della Salute in AR or identical 2D fallback; canonical full title Santa Maria della Salute.

proposals.title: Сомборски неми филм
proposals.interaction: Place a stylized silent-film frame over the camera view, then answer a question about Ernest Bošnjak.

reviewRule: AR tasks are required for the mission but must always be completable via equally rewarded 2D fallback; active in data is not synonymous with implemented in app.
